Package eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.model.dependency.xmldefs

Record Class AIcgdVersionRequirement_1

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.model.dependency.xmldefs.AIcgdVersionRequirement_1
Record Components:
exact - Requires exactly the specified version.
minimum - Sets the minimum allowed version, optionally inclusive.
maximum - Sets a non-strict maximum version that may be relaxed by phased dependency resolution.
maximumStrict - Sets a strict maximum version that must not be exceeded.
exclude - Lists versions that must not be selected.
prefer - Specifies a preferred version to try before falling back to the allowed range.
public record AIcgdVersionRequirement_1(String exact, Map<String,Object> minimum, Map<String,Object> maximum, Boolean maximumStrict, Map<String,Object> exclude, String prefer) extends Record
Defines exact, bounded, excluded, and preferred versions used by Modustro Builder dependency resolution.
